chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, raising it, said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) used to give the authority to the witnesses for (execution of) the Penalties.
ai.seo_question: What was the role of witnesses in executing Islamic penalties according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi illustrates the administrative pragmatism of Imam Ali (peace be upon him), where he delegated the execution of hudud penalties to witnesses, thereby integrating their evidentiary role with judicial enforcement. This practice underscores the flexibility in early Shia jurisprudence regarding the separation or combination of witness testimony and penal execution, reflecting the Imam's efficient governance model. It serves as a key reference for understanding how legal authority was operationalized during the Imamate.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, raising it, said,
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> used to give the authority to the witnesses for (execution of) the Penalties’.
